name: author-talk-skill-path-picker
description: Tiny static demo app for the Pluralsight Author Talk on M365 Copilot, Claude Code, and GitHub Copilot.
_dependency_note: The packages under 'dependencies' are pinned to KNOWN-VULNERABLE versions on purpose. They populate the Dependabot tab with real CVE alerts for the Pluralsight Author Talk demo. None of these packages are imported by the app — see app/public/scripts/. Do not npm install in production.
